# The Shirtless Handyman

> Owner-operated microcement, tadelakt, and seamless-surface installation studio in New Orleans, Louisiana. Founder Ryan Mena personally installs every project — no subcontractors, no franchise, no call center. Serves the greater New Orleans metro including Metairie, Lakeview, Uptown, Mid-City, Bywater, French Quarter, Garden District, Gretna, and Harvey.

- **Business name:** The Shirtless Handyman

## Primary services

- **Microcement installation** — seamless waterproof mineral coating applied over existing tile, concrete, or drywall (when the tile assembly is inspected, cleaned, prepared, and confirmed to be stable). Used for shower walls, floors, kitchen backsplashes, feature walls. Three package tiers: Essential Overlay starting at $5,500 (most qualifying overlays $5,500–$9,500), Signature Grout-Free Bathroom Transformation starting at $15,000 (most Signature transformations $18,000–$35,000+), Luxury Wet Room starting at $30,000 (priced individually).
- **Tadelakt** — traditional Moroccan lime plaster, hand-burnished, naturally waterproof. Tadelakt projects follow the same general service tiers as microcement, but final pricing may differ based on surface preparation, application complexity, finish selection, and wet-area requirements.
- **Rockscape / sculpted feature walls** — foam sculpted and coated in microaggregate to look like carved natural stone. Optional integrated LED lighting. Included in Signature and Luxury tiers, or from $5,500 as a standalone accent.
- **Pool deck resurfacing** — microterrazzo and cocciopesto. UV-stable, slip-resistant, built for NOLA sun. From $5,500.
- **Venetian plaster, Roman clay, Marmorino, Beton cire** — additional decorative and functional seamless finishes.
- **General handyman work** — drywall, fixture installs, painting, pressure washing. Available while on a seamless-surface job. $150–$500 per small job.

## Bathroom pricing structure

Every bathroom I install falls into one of three tiers:

- **Essential Seamless Bathroom Overlay** — Starting at $5,500. Most qualifying overlays range from $5,500–$9,500. Microcement or tadelakt overlay on an existing bathroom footprint. Microcement can often be installed over existing tile after the tile assembly is inspected, cleaned, prepared, and confirmed to be stable. Qualifying Essential Overlay projects may require little or no demolition, and no plumbing changes.
- **Signature Grout-Free Bathroom Transformation** — Starting at $15,000. Most Signature transformations range from $18,000–$35,000+. Full bathroom rebuild in seamless surfaces: walls, floor, and shower in one continuous shell, with new fixtures, lighting, and selective demolition. **Every qualifying Signature Grout-Free Bathroom Transformation includes up to 30 square feet of radiant heated flooring at no additional charge.**
- **Luxury Seamless Wet Room** — Starting at $30,000. Custom luxury projects are priced individually. Fully custom wet-room builds with rockscape or feature-wall integration, radiant floor heating, layered lighting, and bespoke tadelakt or Venetian finishes.

Final pricing depends on substrate condition, square footage, waterproofing requirements, plumbing, fixtures, electrical work, access, and finish complexity. **Positioning:** Premium materials, disciplined preparation, and craftsmanship built for long-term value.

## What makes it different

- Installer works alone. No subcontractors, no crew handed off.
- Uses authentic imported systems (Italian microcement, Moroccan tadelakt lime), not generic concrete overlay.
- Applies directly over existing tile — no demolition, no dumpster, no removed subfloor.
- Fixed all-in pricing after a free in-home consultation. No change orders unless scope changes.
- Written warranty: 1 year on the sealer, 5 years on the substrate bond.

1. **The Seamless Studio (AI preview)** — https://theshirtlesshandyman.com/upload — upload a photo of any room, get 3 AI-generated design previews of the finished space in microcement / tadelakt / rockscape with a real cost estimate. Free, no account required.
2. **Self-serve calendar** — https://theshirtlesshandyman.com/book — pick a free in-home walkthrough, phone consult, site prep visit, or project start date directly from Ryan's real availability. Mon–Sat, 8am–5pm Central.
3. **Text Ryan directly** — 504-264-4919. Average response under 1 hour.
4. **Quote form** — https://theshirtlesshandyman.com — quick name + phone form that texts Ryan a lead notification instantly.
